en.text:
Passively grants 45% faster Base Class Ability Regeneration (does not function with <arc/>Thruster).

Replaces Grenade Ability with Barri-Nade on Class Ability usage. Barri-Nade is lost if Class Ability fully recharges.

Barri-Nade spawns your selected Barricade type on the impact location and inherits the benefits of Aspects such as <void/>Bastion and <strand/>Drengr's Lash. Non-barricade class abilities default to Towering Barricade and match its cooldown.

Enemies within 5? meters of the Barri-Nade's impact location are disoriented. Spawned Barricade deals no Contact damage within 2 seconds of its creation.

Collecting three Orbs of Power grants 'Enhanced Barri-Nade', causing the next Barri-Nade to spawn three Barricades in a circular formation on impact.

Aspect effects of barricades stack outside of the <arc/>Storm's Keep's <arc/>Bolt Charge generation.

Barri-Nade has no collision with enemies/* and objects that are not part of the map by default*/.
